pulls.title: Clarify manifest models and WASM metadata extensions
pulls.author: Yuanyuan4666
pulls.body:
This PR updates the draft with the following changes:

- Clarifies the roles of Platform Manifest, Data Collection Manifest, and SUIT Manifest.
- Adds WASM/UBI capability metadata examples for Platform Manifest.
- Adds runtime collection context examples for Data Collection Manifest.
- Clarifies that SUIT-specific execution parameters are extensions associated with existing SUIT mechanisms.
- Introduces a separate UBI Resource Constraint Policy model referenced by manifests through policy identifiers.

The changes aim to separate device capability description, runtime collection context, software delivery, and resource governance.
